WITNESSETH,that the party of the first part,in consideration of ten dollars and other valuableconsideration 8209 paid by the party of the second part,does hereby grant and release unto the party of the second part,the heirs or successors and assigns of the party of the second part forever, Lot 46 ALLthat certain lot,piece orparcelofland,with thebuildings andimprovements thereonerected,situate,lying and being in the Third Ward,Douglaston in the Borough and County of Queens, City and State of New York. more particularly described as follows: BEGINNING at a point on the easterly side of Overbrook Place, distant 40 feet southerly from the corner formed by the intersection of the easterly side of OverbrookPlace with the southerly side of Van Zandt Avenue,as said Place and Avenue are shown on Amended Map of Alley Park East filed in the Queens County Register's Office, August 12, 1935 as Map No. 6717; RUNNING THENCE easterly at right angles to the easterly side of Overbrook Place, 100 feet; THENCE southerly parallel with Overbrook Place,40 feet; THENCE westerly at right angles to the last mentioned course,100 feet to the easterly side of Overbrook Place; Being the same premises conveyed to grantors herein by deed in reel 4086 p.1521.The grantors herein are the same persons as the grantees in deed in reel 4086 p. 1521 TOGETHER,with allright,tite andintrest,if any,of the party of the first partin and to any streets and roads abutting the above described premises to the center lines thereof;TOGETHERwith the appurtenances and all the estate and rights of the party of the first part in and to said premises;TO HAVE AND TO HOLD the premises herein granted unto the party of the second part. the heirs or successors and assigns of the party of the second part forever. AND the party of thefirst part covenants that the party of the first part has not done or suffered anything whereby the said premises have been encumbered in any way whatever,except as aforesaid. AND the party of the first part,in compliance withSection 13of theLienLaw,covenants that the party of the first part will receive theconsiderationfor this conveyance andwill hold the right toreceive suchconsideration as trust fund to be applied first for the purpose of paying the cost of the improvement and will apply the same first to the payment of the cost of the improvement before using any part of the total of the same for any other purpose.
